design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER task 0 (fleet_invoicing, env_0062), round 2. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,4]; the early-pay credit (root) takes 6 factors, the over-limit dispute filing 4.

ROUND-2 CHANGES (audit round 1: F-1 SOURCE-POLICY RED). The dispute rule now declares, as a scoped overwrite of fleet_evt_invoice 'A ticket above the account's ticket_approval_limit needs the fleet manager's approval before work starts.', the driver emergency authorization (safety and weekend allowances) that it adds to the authorized amount, for a ticket a business disputes under this rule only; every other ticket stays under the base sentence. The off-roster tier was dropped from ticket_measure (work on an off-roster vehicle is never chargeable, which is a different dispute); the method now decides only the measured ticket amount (split ticket / single invoice net of credit memos already on it / invoice alone) and no longer subtracts the authorized amount, so no factor reads another factor's output. The early-pay paid-in-full test now also accepts a remittance that already deducted the discount (base sentence 'a full payment that already deducted the discount is applied as payment plus the discount row'). Seed: every tire invoice is now priced from its tire set under tires_purchase_ticket and the base fleet discount (10% on the price net of instant savings, excluding disposal, plus 7.5% tax on this taxable account); four tire sets added, the 2025-08-15 dispute moved to unit 4167 (set on file), the 2025-09-15 set on unit 4108 got its fleet invoice, two repair invoices added to keep the twelve-month volume in its band (21,261.30). Scored values unchanged: 156.29 and 17.78.

WHY A GOOD TEST. The caller asks only for a missing early-pay discount. The agent must read in the early-pay rule that a partly paid invoice earns the discount only after an open over-limit dispute covers the unpaid part, see that no dispute exists (150.00 open after the 814.41 remittance), hand the dispute filing to the caller with an amount it computes from the approval limit, the split ticket, the emergency authorization and the repeat deductible, and then compute a six-factor discount on the world after the filing.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims fleet_ext_overlimit_dispute (file_fleet_overlimit_dispute_8d937b85, owner=user) and fleet_ext_early_pay_credit (credit_fleet_early_pay_23cbfed3). Task 1 claims the other four policies; scopes are disjoint and cover all six.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root fleet_ext_early_pay_credit; edge -> fleet_ext_overlimit_dispute, value_input, gate disputed_open, state form, sentence 'The early-pay discount on an invoice that a remittance has paid only in part is credited only after an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket registered for that invoice covers the part left unpaid.' (connective 'only after'; record-visible state; no tool, id or code token; exactly one write creates an open unauthorized_purchase dispute: the over-limit filing). False at the opening: the three dispute rows name other invoices and none is open; remittance 814.41 on the 964.41 invoice leaves 150.00. Order: filing (step 13), credit (step 15). Skipping the filing gives 0.00 instead of 17.78.

FACTOR CARD - over-limit dispute (156.29; all-baseline 214.41 = 964.41 - 750.00):
- ticket_measure (method). Pairwise tiers: split vs single-with-credits differ by the count of same-day same-store invoices (2 vs 1); single-with-credits vs plain differ by credit memos on the invoice (>0 vs 0); split vs plain by the count. World: split ticket (FI-42410517 tires 964.41 + FI-42410518 alignment 141.88, unit 4127, 2026-10-10, store 4318) -> 1,106.29; baseline 14.41.
- safety_work_allowance (parameter): tire work -> 100.00; baseline 256.29.
- weekend_ticket_allowance (parameter): Saturday -> 50.00; baseline 206.29.
- repeat_unapproved_deductible (parameter): one qualifying resolved dispute (2026-04-09) -> 50.00; near-misses 2025-08-21 (older than twelve whole months) and 2026-07-14 (missing_po, no credit); baseline 206.29.

FACTOR CARD - early-pay credit (17.78; all-baseline 9.64): remit_speed_points (multi-source: 3 days AND no late charge in twelve months) 0.50 -> 13.74; approval_tenure_points 66 months 0.25 -> 15.76; tire_care_rotation_points (cross tires: three rotations) 0.10 -> 16.97; invoiced_volume_points (21,261.30) 0.10 -> 16.97; remit_channel_points (ACH) 0.25 -> 15.76; disputed_invoice_base (method; pairwise: more-than-half vs some differ by the disputed share, some vs none by open dispute rows) undisputed part 808.12 -> 21.22.
Factor independence (checked mechanically, transitively): every factor binding reads only its own bindings or plain record selections; the allowances, deductible and measured amount meet only in the plain unapproved-part and result bindings.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. fleet_evt_credit_memo.within_dispute_window: 2026-10-10 + 45 = 2026-11-24 >= 2026-10-14 (2026-11-25 would fail). fleet_evt_payment.within_early_pay_period: last qualifying date 2026-10-20; remittance 2026-10-13 inside. Both bound to FI-42410517. Overwrites: fleet_evt_invoice approval sentence (scoped, dispute only); fleet_evt_payment 'only when the remittance pays it in full' and the discount sentence; program-0 and credit-memo sentences inherited.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target FI-42410517 (tires, unit 4127, ticket T-44018326), the source of the most recent remittance; the alignment invoice of the same ticket enters only the combined measure. Older invoices, the open 2026-09-24 invoice of another unit and the earlier disputes are excluded.

PERSONA. Brisk office manager; asks only for the early-pay discount; states she held back 150.00 for the unapproved overage; identity by phone + email; files the dispute only after the agent explains it; closes when told the discount is credited.

EDGE PROBES. Remittance tie on the latest date: none seeded (pointer would be ambiguous). Absent remittance: no invoice, no discount (rule tier: credited only on the invoice a remittance was applied to). A credit memo already on a single-invoice ticket: middle tier. A second open dispute of another reason on the same invoice: counted in the disputed amount by the rule's words. Weekday from a fixed Saturday reference (mod 7, negative-safe). No division by zero (the share test multiplies).

STANDARD SOLUTION / VERIFICATION. Locate + verify (phone, email) -> fleet account, ledger, disputes, roster, vehicles, stores, tire sets, tire events, alignment plans/events -> user files dispute 156.29 -> credit 17.78. Recomputed with the real tools on the handling-time world (gates check_compute / replay).

ROUND-3 CHANGES. Tire factor of the early-pay rate now counts tire rotations (tire care points; three rotations less than twelve whole months ago -> 0.10, tier and value unchanged); three rotation rows seeded (2026-04-14 unit 4133, 2026-09-02 unit 4150, and the 2025-10-14 unit 4167 near-miss at exactly twelve whole months). Channel ladder states ACH/WIRE with CHK. Rule surfaces restated so each states its own rule (no forward pointers). Values unchanged: 156.29, 17.78.
user_scenario: You are Delphine Arbuckle-Mensah, office manager for Quarry Hollow Paving & Sealcoat Co., a paving and sealcoating outfit south of Columbus that runs its trucks on a Crestline fleet account. You are calling Crestline fleet customer care on a Wednesday morning between crew dispatches; you are brisk and a little clipped, but polite, and you like straight answers. Last Saturday your driver took truck unit 4127 into the Groveport store and came out with four new tires and an alignment, and the ticket ran past the $750 approval limit you set on the account without anyone calling you for an OK. You paid the tire invoice, FI-42410517, on Monday's ACH run that posted Tuesday, but you held back $150.00 of it because of the unapproved overage, and you paid well inside the ten-day early-pay window. Your accounting screen shows no early-pay discount on that invoice, and getting that discount credited today is why you are calling. You open by saying you are calling about the early-pay discount on invoice FI-42410517 for unit 4127. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name, Delphine Arbuckle-Mensah; to confirm your identity you offer the account phone number 6145550427 and your email d.arbuckle-mensah@quarryhollowpaving.com. Only if they ask for something more do you add the billing ZIP 43207, and you give your date of birth, 1979-05-18, only if they insist. You do not know Crestline's internal reference numbers. If they ask about the payment, the ACH trace on your bank screen reads ACH 441933620187 and the amount was $814.41. If they ask about the work, the driver had the tires and the alignment done on the same visit and nobody in your office approved anything over the limit. If the agent explains that the part you held back has to be put on file as a dispute and that you need to confirm it yourself, you agree; once they hand you the step to file it, you file it with exactly the details they read out and you read back what your screen shows. You do not question the dispute amount they quote unless it is more than the whole invoice. When the agent tells you the early-pay discount has been credited on the invoice, you thank them and end the call without asking for anything else. If instead the agent says no discount can be credited, you say you will take it up with your controller and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the business profile from the account phone number the caller gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to this customer reference; without it nothing can be found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller is the business's authorized contact with two matching details (phone and email).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before any fleet business is looked into or transacted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Crestline Fleet Commercial account: program, approval date, ticket approval limit (750.00) and balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the account reference, the program's early-pay percentage and period, the approval date for the tenure points, and the ticket approval limit for the disputed amount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole ledger: the 2026-10-10 tire and alignment invoices on unit 4127, the 2026-10-13 ACH remittance of 814.41, twelve months of invoices, the late-charge history and the earlier dispute credits.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the invoice the latest remittance short-paid (150.00 left open), the split ticket (two invoices same day, same store), the remittance speed and channel, the 12-month invoiced volume and that no late charge was assessed in the last twelve months.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the dispute history: two earlier unapproved over-limit disputes (2025-08-21 and 2026-04-09, both resolved with a credit) and a missing-PO dispute resolved without credit; none open on the tire invoice.

Basis: the rule 'contests that part by filing a dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket on the invoice its most recent remittance was applied to'; the most recent remittance (2026-10-13, ACH 441933620187, 814.41) names this invoice as source, and the caller names FI-42410517. argument_uniqueness_tracing.disputed_amount: Value 156.29. Invoice FI-42410517 amount 964.41, the invoice the latest remittance (2026-10-13, ACH 441933620187) was applied to. Unit 4127 has two invoices dated 2026-10-10 from store 4318 (tires 964.41, alignment 141.88), so the split-ticket measure applies: measured amount 1,106.29. Authorized amount = ticket approval limit 750.00 + driver emergency authorization: safety allowance 100.00 (the ticket includes tire work) + weekend allowance 50.00 (2026-10-10 is a Saturday) = 900.00. Unapproved part 1,106.29 - 900.00 = 206.29. Repeat deductible 50.00: exactly one earlier unapproved over-limit dispute resolved with a credit less than twelve whole months ago (registered 2026-04-09); the 2025-08-21 one is more than twelve whole months old and the 2026-07-14 one is a missing-PO dispute resolved without credit. 206.29 - 50.00 = 156.29, within 0.00..964.41.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_fleet_txn_id: Value a0550613-f62a-4981-a52c-68f230992383. Basis: the rule 'The early-pay discount is credited on the invoice the most recent remittance was applied to'; the 2026-10-13 remittance is the latest and names FI-42410517. argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 17.78. Invoice 964.41 dated 2026-10-10, remittance 2026-10-13 (3 days, inside the 10-day period). After the step-13 filing: applied 814.41, open 150.00, under open dispute 156.29, so nothing is left open beyond the dispute (the test also allows the discount itself). Discount base: 156.29 is no more than half of 964.41, so the base is 964.41 - 156.29 = 808.12. Rate = program 1.00 + speed 0.50 (within 3 days, no late charge less than twelve whole months ago; the 2025-09-30 late charge is exactly 12 whole months old) + tenure 0.25 (approved 2021-03-15, 66 whole months) + tire care 0.10 (3 rotations in twelve months; the 2025-10-14 rotation is exactly twelve whole months old and excluded) + volume 0.10 (invoices of the last twelve months total 21,261.30) + channel 0.25 (reference carries ACH) = 2.20. 808.12 x 2.20 / 100 = 17.7786, rounded once: 17.78.

safety_work_allowance (parameter): the ticket includes tire work -> 100.00; baseline nothing -> authorized 800.00, final 256.29.
weekend_ticket_allowance (parameter): 2026-10-10 is a Saturday -> 50.00; baseline nothing -> final 206.29.

repeat_unapproved_deductible (parameter): one earlier unapproved over-limit dispute resolved with a credit, registered 2026-04-09 (less than twelve whole months); 2025-08-21 is older; the 2026-07-14 missing-PO dispute is another reason -> 50.00; baseline nothing -> final 206.29.

plain reads: invoice of the latest remittance = FI-42410517 (964.41); approval limit 750.00; authorized 900.00; unapproved part max(0, 1,106.29 - 900.00) = 206.29; result round(min(964.41, max(0, 206.29 - 50.00)), 2) = 156.29.

edges.condition: fleet_invoice_disputes carries a row with dispute_status open and dispute_reason unauthorized_purchase whose fleet_txn_id is the invoice the most recent remittance was applied to, and its disputed_amount is at least the amount the remittances, discounts and credit memos leave open on that invoice.
edges.policy_source: The early-pay discount on an invoice that a remittance has paid only in part is credited only after an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket registered for that invoice covers the part left unpaid.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: No dispute row names invoice FI-42410517: the three seeded disputes name FI-40815807, FI-41804027 and FI-42107096 and none is open, while the latest remittance (814.41 on the 964.41 invoice) leaves 150.00 open. With nothing under open dispute the remittance leaves 150.00 open beyond the dispute, so the early-pay discount is not owed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The filing at step 13 creates an open unauthorized_purchase dispute on FI-42410517 for 156.29 >= 150.00 open, so disputed_open = 156.29 and the open amount beyond the dispute is -6.29 (<= 0).

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the dispute filing must precede the early-pay credit (the prerequisite sentence pins it). Reversed, the credit evaluated on the opening world is 0.00 (150.00 left open, nothing disputed), a different terminal state; there are no parallel edges.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the filing leaves disputed_open = 0.00 and 150.00 open beyond any dispute, so the early-pay credit evaluates to 0.00 instead of 17.78 and the dispute row (156.29) is missing from the terminal state (verify.py run without the step-13 write: RESULT 0).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the early-pay discount and explains, as fact, that 150.00 was held back for an unapproved overage; it never names a dispute filing, never asks whether something must be filed first, and agrees to file only after the agent explains it. The policy id fleet_ext_overlimit_dispute does not occur in user_scenario.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: credit_fleet_early_pay_23cbfed3 books the discount entry and lowers the balance for whatever arguments it receives; it reads no dispute and never refuses (task_tools.py body: one ctx.create on fleet_transactions and one ctx.update of outstanding_balance). file_fleet_overlimit_dispute_8d937b85 creates the dispute row as given and checks nothing.
